name: funkin-hub
description: A JavaScript-based central hub and toolkit for Friday Night Funkin' modding.

scripts.prepare:web: rimraf www && mkdirwww && copyfiles -u 0 index.html src/**/* www
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
